content: Paulo Ɔnɔ́tɩn
Nkenú ɔma a, igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn Anania mʋa Yudafɔ ahandɛ akʋ pʋ́ Mose mbla ɔbɩpʋ́ ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Tertulo bɛba Kaesarea. Bɛbá bɛkla asʋ́n ánɩ́ bʋbʋ tsu Paulo ɩwɩ súná ɔmásʋ́ ogyípʋ́ Felike.
Bɛtɩ Paulo bɛlɩɩ́. Mʋ́ʋ́ Tetulo lɛ́kla mʋ asʋ́n ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Onumnyampʋ Felike, fahá iwilwii laba ɔmá ánfɩtɔ. Fʋ́ nyánsa lalá atɔ́ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bwɛ́ anɩ ɔmá ánfɩtɔ.
Fʋ́ bwɛhɛ́ legyi anɩ ansɩ́ ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́. Fʋ́dɛ́ atɔ́ bwɛ.
Mmedéklé mbɛ́ɛ néyintá fʋ́ brɛ́ tsɔtsɔ. Mʋ́ sʋ nokókóli fʋ, nya klʋn ha anɩ, afunu anɩ asʋ́n tinbí ánfɩ.
Anɩlawun ánɩ́ atɔ́ oyintápʋ́ oyin ánfɩ gyí. Ɔtɛhá kpokiti tɛdá Yudafɔtɔ ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́á ɔtɔyɔ́. Ɔtráa ogyi Nasaret ɔpasua ámʋ Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́.
Alakle ɔpʋ ifin da Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ɩnʋ, asa ɔkláa ogyá anɩlɛ́kɩtá mʋ.
Nɩ́ fʋ́ onutó fɛfɩ́tɛ́ mʋ a, fówun ánɩ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ anɩdɛ́blɩ́ tsú mʋ ɩwɩ ánfɩ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋ mʋ́tɔ́ ntɛ́ɛ ɩma mʋ́tɔ́.”
Ɩnʋ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ botsulá mʋ́sʋ́ bɛɛ, asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ alablɩ́ ámʋ bʋ mʋ́tɔ́.
Paulo Ɔnɔ́lɛ Felike Ansɩ́tɔ́
Ɔmásʋ́ ogyípʋ́ Felike lɔ́bwɛ Paulo ɩbɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔlɛ́ mʋ ɔnɔ́. Ɩnʋ Paulo lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nyin ánɩ́ fʋdɛ asʋ́n gyí ɔmá ánfɩtɔ ɩlawá ɔpá. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɩbʋ mɩ ɔdwɛ ánɩ́ nɛ́lɛ mɩ́ ɔnɔ́ fʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Nobwíí ɩpa, fɛ́talɩ́ fɩ́tɛ́ nú ánɩ́ ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á nɔyɔ Yerusalem yósum Bulu, ɩmɔkʋ́dʋn nkɛ dúanyɔ.
Mɩ́ anyabá ánfɩ bʋmowun mɩ́a ɔhaa agyi nwɛ́ɛn Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ɩnʋ. Bʋmowun mɩ́ anha kpokiti ɩda Yudafɔ ofíakpa kʋkʋ ntɛ́ɛ ɔtɩnɛtɩnɛ wúlu amʋtɔ.
Bʋma asʋansʋá bɔ́pʋgyi adánsɩɛ ánɩ́ amʋ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ bʋ mʋ́tɔ́.
Támɛ natsúlá ánɩ́ ntosúm anɩ anáin Bulu tsʋn anɩ Wíe Ɔkpa ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋdɛ mʋ́ tɩ ɔpasua laláhɛ amʋsʋ. Nɔhɔ Mose Mbla ámʋ pʋ́ mʋ́á Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɔwanlɩ́n tswɩ ɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́ gyi.
Ndɛ ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ fɛ́ alɩá amʋ́ ɛ́ bʋdɛ ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ ánɩ́ Bulu ɔbɔ́kʋsʋ́a aha yilé pʋ́ aha laláhɛ fɛ́ɛ́ tsú afúlitɔ ɛkɛ kʋ́.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ntɔbɔ́ mbɔ́dɩ́ ánɩ́ mɩ́ klʋn méetsiá há mɩ́ pɔ́n Bulu mʋa anyánkpʋ́sa fɛ́ɛ́ ansɩ́tɔ́ brégyíbrɛ́.
“Ɩ́nɩá nɛdalɩ Yerusalem ɩlawá ɔpá á, nayínkí ba ɩnʋ, napʋ́ atokiehɛ́ nɛbá mɩ́ ahá abʋpʋha ahiánfɔ, mɩ́ anha Bulu igyí.
Mʋ́ ɔbwɛkpá mbʋ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ɩnʋ. Brɛ́á nɔgyʋráa ɩwɩ tá amándɩ́ɛ́ ámʋ ɔnɔ́ á, bɛba bɔtʋ mɩ́ ɩnʋ. Megyí mɩ́a ɔdɔm kʋkʋ lɔ́yɔ ɩnʋ. Kpokiti kʋkʋ ɛ́ mɛda ɩnʋ.
Yudafɔ akʋ botsu Asia ɔmátɔ́ ba bʋbʋ ɩnʋ. Nɩ́ nɔbwɛ ɩtɔ laláhɛ kʋ á, tɛkɩ amʋ́ kʋ́ráá ɔbɛ́ba bɛbláa fʋ, mɩ́a amʋ́nyɔ abɛ́blɩ́ mʋ́.
Nɩ́ ɩbɔ́wa alɛ́ kʋ́ráá á, ha ahá ánfɩ onutó abʋblɩ tsitsa oduá Yudafɔ asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ bowun mɩ́ ɩwɩ, brɛ́á bɔpʋ mɩ́ ya amʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Asʋn kua kʋlɛ pɛ́á nɔkplʋ́n blɩ́ brɛ́á nlɩɩ́ Yudafɔ asʋ́n agyípʋ́ amʋ ansɩ́tɔ́ gyí, ‘Mlɩdɛ́ mɩ́ asʋ́n gyí ndɛ, tsúfɛ́ nohogyi ánɩ́ awupʋ́ bɛ́lakʋ́sʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ.’ ”
Ɩ́nɩá onumnyampʋ Felike yin anɩ Wíe ɔkpa ámʋ wankláán sʋ á, olotu asʋ́n ámʋ hɩ́ɛ́. Ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ɔhandɛ Lisia ɔbá nfɩ á, nówun alɩá nɔ́mɔ asʋ́n ámʋ ɔnɔ́.”
Ɔlɛbláa ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ɔhandɛ ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ogyóo Paulo ɩwɩ wankláán, ɔha mʋ otsia iwilwiitɔ. Ɔhá mʋ aba ɔkpa abʋkɩ mʋsʋ.
Paulo Felike Mʋa Mʋ Ka Drusila Ansɩ́tɔ́ Lɩɩ́
Nkɛ kpalobí kʋ ɔma a, Felike mʋa mʋ ka Drusila ánɩ́ ogyi Yudayintse bɛba. Felike lɛ́ha bɛyɛ́kpa Paulo ba, ɔlɔbɔtɔɩ́ tsú mʋ hógyi ánɩ́ ɔbʋ Kristo Yesutɔ ɩwɩ súná amʋ́.

Támɛ brɛ́á ɔdɛtɔɩ́ tsú yilébwɛ, ɩwɩsʋgyí pʋ́ Bulu asʋ́n ogyíkɛ́ amʋ́ʋ́ ɩbá ámʋ ɩwɩ á, ifú lɛkɩtá Felike. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛbláa Paulo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Kʋ yinki asa. Nenyá brɛ́ wankláán kʋ á, nɛ́latɩ́ fʋ́.”
Brɛ́ ámʋtɔ fɛ́ɛ́ Felike lɛ́kɩ ɔkpa ánɩ́ Paulo obódunká tɔkʋ bɛha mʋ ɔnɔ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɩbʋ nʋ bʋ ɩnʋ á, alapina wa abí bayɛ́tɩ Paulo, mʋa mʋnyɔ batɔ́ɩ́.
Nfinyɔ ɔma a, Felike lɛ́natɩ́. Porkio Festo lébetsiá mʋ obíásʋ́. Ɩ́nɩá Felike déklé ɔbɛ́ɛ, mʋ asʋ́n ɩwá Yudafɔ ámʋ ɔdwɛ sʋ á, olesi Paulo wá obu nátɩ́.
